                continue

                continue
            
            # Skip duplicates
            dup_key = (city_id, year, indicator_id)
            if dup_key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(dup_key)
            
            writer.writerow({
                'city_id': city_id,
                'city_name': city_name,
                'year': year,
                'indicator_id': indicator_id,
                'indicator_name': indicator_name,
                'value': value,
                'unit': unit
            })

    # Define paths
    base_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
    project_root = os.path.dirname(base_dir)

    print(f"Output written to {output_path}")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
